HALCYON INSTRUMENTS, INC.
2026 EQUITY INCENTIVE PLAN

NOTICE OF STOCK OPTION GRANT

Halcyon Instruments, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), hereby grants to the Optionee named below an option (the "Option") to purchase the number of shares of the Company's Common Stock set forth below, at the exercise price set forth below, subject to the terms of the Halcyon Instruments, Inc. 2026 Equity Incentive Plan (the "Plan") and the Stock Option Agreement attached as Exhibit A, both of which are incorporated by reference. Capitalized terms used and not defined in this Notice have the meanings given to them in the Plan.

Optionee:                          Ingrid Sørensen
Grant Date:                        July 6, 2026
Vesting Commencement Date:         July 6, 2026
Number of Shares Subject to Option: 480,000 shares of Common Stock
Exercise Price Per Share:          $2.14
Total Exercise Price:              $1,027,200.00
Type of Option:                    Incentive Stock Option, to the maximum extent permitted by Section 422 of the Internal Revenue Code, and a Nonstatutory Stock Option as to the remainder
Expiration Date:                   July 5, 2036

Vesting Schedule. Twenty-five percent (25%) of the Shares subject to the Option vest on July 6, 2027, and 1/48th of the Shares subject to the Option vest on the corresponding day of each month thereafter, so that the Option is fully vested on July 6, 2030, in each case subject to the Optionee's Continuous Service through the applicable vesting date.

Termination of Service. If the Optionee's Continuous Service terminates for any reason other than death, Disability, or Cause, the vested portion of the Option remains exercisable for three (3) months after the termination date. If Continuous Service terminates by reason of death or Disability, the vested portion remains exercisable for twelve (12) months. If Continuous Service terminates for Cause, the Option terminates in its entirety on the termination date, whether or not then vested. In no event may the Option be exercised after the Expiration Date.

Incentive Stock Option Limit. To the extent the aggregate fair market value, determined as of the Grant Date, of the shares with respect to which incentive stock options are exercisable for the first time by the Optionee during any calendar year exceeds $100,000, the options covering the excess shares are treated as Nonstatutory Stock Options in accordance with Section 422(d) of the Internal Revenue Code.

Method of Exercise. The Option is exercised by delivering to the Company a notice of exercise in the form the Company prescribes, together with payment of the aggregate exercise price in cash, by check, by wire transfer, by a cashless exercise through a broker if the Company then permits one, or by any other method the Administrator approves. The Company will not issue any Shares until the exercise price and all applicable withholding obligations have been satisfied in full.

Tax Withholding. The Optionee is responsible for all taxes arising from the grant, vesting, exercise, or disposition of the Option and the Shares. The Company may withhold from any amounts otherwise payable to the Optionee, or require the Optionee to remit, the amount necessary to satisfy any federal, state, local, or foreign withholding obligation. The Company has made no representation as to the tax consequences of the Option, and the Optionee is advised to consult a tax advisor.

Disqualifying Disposition. If the Optionee disposes of Shares acquired on exercise of an incentive stock option within two (2) years after the Grant Date or one (1) year after the transfer of the Shares to the Optionee, the Optionee shall notify the Company in writing within ten (10) days of the disposition.

Transferability. The Option is not transferable except by will or the laws of descent and distribution, and during the Optionee's lifetime is exercisable only by the Optionee.

No Right to Continued Service. Nothing in this Notice, the Plan, or the Stock Option Agreement confers on the Optionee any right to continue in the service of the Company, or interferes in any way with the right of the Company to terminate that service at any time, with or without Cause.

Section 409A. The Option is intended to be exempt from Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code as a stock right granted with an exercise price no less than the fair market value of a Share on the Grant Date, determined in good faith by the Board in reliance on an independent valuation, and shall be construed accordingly.

Governing Law. This Notice is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.

Entire Agreement. This Notice, the Plan, and the Stock Option Agreement constitute the entire agreement of the parties with respect to the Option and supersede all prior discussions and understandings concerning it.

By accepting the Option, the Optionee acknowledges receipt of the Plan and the Stock Option Agreement, agrees to be bound by their terms, and accepts the Option on the terms set forth above.
